messages:
alex_m: Heads-up — prod eu-west-1 GPU host flapping, incident #INC-3345 opened. Putting today's 12:00 CET release (orbit v2.3.1) on hold. @deploy-bot please pin the release and block the window.
deploy-bot: Automated: release orbit v2.3.1 flagged as HOLD by alex_m at 3345007777. Pinned: true. Notifying owners.
priya: ack. Do we want to rollback the canary that went out at 11:40?
miguel_r: Not yet — symptoms look infrastructure (host detach), not model regression. Suggest: keep canary paused, do not rollback code. Swap traffic from the flapping pool to fallback pool (k8s nodepool 'inference-fallback'), then run smoke. If smoke green, reschedule full rollout.
ops-oncall: I'm running host checks now (checking host-attach logs, nvml errors). ETA 10m. If we fail health checks I'll cordon/drain the affected nodes.
sarah_pm: I'll update release notes and the customer-facing schedule. Proposed new windows: 17:00 CET (primary) or 20:00 CET (fallback). Which do you prefer? @miguel_r @ops-oncall
miguel_r: Prefer 17:00 if ops can confirm node pool health by 16:30. Otherwise push to 20:00.
ops-oncall: Health checks show repeated attach errors on 3 hosts. Draining now, will move workloads to inference-fallback. Should be stable in ~18m.
priya: OK that sounds good. After fallback swap, can we run a small rolling canary (5% traffic) to confirm latency and kv-cache behavior?
miguel_r: Yes — configure canary route: 
```
route: orbit-canary
weight: 5
model: orbit-v2.3.1
pool: inference-fallback
```
Do we want auto-rollback on P90 latency > 300ms?
alex_m: Yes, set auto-rollback threshold as you suggested, and tag the run with "incident-3345". I'll unblock the deploy once ops gives the green.
deploy-bot: Noted. Canary config queued; auto-rollback: P90 > 300ms. Release window remains PINNED but status: HOLD -> READY_TO_RETRY after ops confirmation.
sarah_pm: I'll send a brief customer note: "Release delayed due to infrastructure flapping in eu-west-1; new ETA 17:00 CET pending validation"
ops-oncall: Swapped pools, drained bad hosts. Basic smoke passed (token gen, chat flow sample). No GPU errors in last 5m.
priya: Running 5% canary now. Monitoring logs & latency dashboards.
miguel_r: Observing kv-cache hit rate slightly lower on fallback (63% vs 70) — expected. Latency P50/P90 within thresholds so far.
priya: Canary stable for 7m. No errors. Recommend proceeding with rollout at 17:00 CET.
alex_m: OK proceeding to reschedule full rollout to 17:00 CET. I'll update the change window and remove HOLD once deploybot triggers. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
sarah_pm: I'll post external update and update the release calendar.
deploy-bot: Release orbit v2.3.1 scheduled for 3345013800 (17:00 CET). PIN: true, status: SCHEDULED.
ops-oncall: I'll stay on until the end of the window to watch for regressions.
priya: leaving monitoring in case of anything.
miguel_r: tagging the rollout with incident-3345-notes for postmortem.
alex_m: thread closed once rollout completes. If anything changes ping here"
